svg.title: Axiom controller enclosure blueprint (case)
svg.text: AXIOM CONTROLLER · ENCLOSURE BLUEPRINT · ABS INSTRUMENT CASE EDITION

250 × 190 × 80 mm ABS instrument case (removable front/rear panels), internals from 4–5 mm foam board, hot glued. Interior is an estimate: measure yours and update the preset. All dimensions in mm. Outer 190 W × 250 D × 80 H. Generated by make_drawings.py (case preset).
Front of the console at the bottom. Dashed = lid openings above.
Nominal, from the outer LEFT and FRONT edges. Confirm by marking through from inside with parts in place.
Throttle knob push-fits on the stem
(not glued) so the lid can lift off.
Viewed from the left; front of the console on the left. Sled at mid travel, dashed at both ends.
HC-SR04 hidden behind the sensor wall
Reflector plate: flat, square to the sensor
Sled runs on the tunnel floor
Top shell held by the case's own screws
top: base + runners, plate at the back
• Base 48 × 50; runners 2× 50 × 15 glued on edge along the sides.
• Plate 48 × 70: smooth card or plastic, braced square with 2 triangular gussets.
• Stem 10 × 105 (3 layers laminated) 25 in front of the plate.
• Collar 30 × 20 glued to the stem just under the lid stops the sled lifting or tilting.
• Line the tunnel floor and walls with packing tape: it slides smoothly and quietly.
7 · PARTS (researched sizes — measure yours, clones vary)
Corral of card strips on the floor, no glue on the PCB
Hot glue PCB edges behind the sensor wall, on its side
Hot glue PCB to the tower top; shim for clearance
Body in the front-wall square, glued from inside
Stays on the breadboard, under the grille
M–F, sockets point into the electronics bay
Only 1 M–F left: wrap the GND leg round an M–M pin and glue, or skip SW
M–M; extend reach by hopping through a spare breadboard row
Measure the interior; update the case preset and rerun this script. Print templates-case.svg at 100%.
Cut openings with the Dremel (low–medium speed so ABS doesn't melt): top-shell slot and stick hole, front-panel square, rear-panel USB hole.
Build the tunnel (divider + sensor wall) and sled from foam board; hot glue the tunnel to the case floor. Tape-line it.
Glue HC-SR04 behind the window, tower + joystick, trigger button; place Uno and breadboard.
Wire (see wiring.svg), close the case, push on the knob. Calibrate in game: Options → Calibrate.
